table:columns.name: names
table:columns.description: Properties defining the names of a feature. The struct carries a primary name, optional common names by language, and optional rules. Quoted from the namesContainer definition in the Overture schema.

table:columns.name: height
table:columns.description: Height of the building or part in meters. The height is the distance from the lowest point to the highest point.

table:columns.name: min_height
table:columns.description: The height of the bottom part of building in meters. Used if a building or part of building starts above the ground level.

table:columns.name: is_underground
table:columns.description: Whether the entire building or part is completely below ground. This is useful for rendering which typically omits these buildings or styles them differently because they are not visible above ground. This is different than the level column which is used to indicate z-ordering of elements and negative values may be above ground.

table:columns.name: num_floors
table:columns.description: Number of above-ground floors of the building or part.

table:columns.name: num_floors_underground
table:columns.description: Number of below-ground floors of the building or part.

table:columns.name: min_floor
table:columns.description: The "start" floor of this building or part. Indicates that the building or part is "floating" and its bottom-most floor is above ground level, usually because it is part of a larger building in which some parts do reach down to ground level. An example is a building that has an entry road or driveway at ground level into an interior courtyard, where part of the building bridges above the entry road. This property may sometimes be populated when min_height is missing and in these cases can be used as a proxy for min_height.

table:columns.name: facade_color
table:columns.description: The color (name or color triplet) of the facade of a building or building part in hexadecimal

table:columns.name: facade_material
table:columns.description: The outer surface material of building facade.

table:columns.name: roof_material
table:columns.description: The outermost material of the roof.

table:columns.name: roof_shape
table:columns.description: The shape of the roof

table:columns.name: roof_direction
table:columns.description: Bearing of the roof ridge line in degrees.

table:columns.name: roof_orientation
table:columns.description: Orientation of the roof shape relative to the footprint shape. Either "along" or "across".

table:columns.name: roof_color
table:columns.description: The color (name or color triplet) of the roof of a building or building part in hexadecimal

table:columns.name: roof_height
table:columns.description: The height of the building roof in meters. This represents the distance from the base of the roof to the highest point of the roof.

table:columns.name: level
table:columns.description: Z-order of the feature where 0 is visual level

table:columns.name: sources
table:columns.description: The array of source information for the properties of a given feature, with each entry being a source object which lists the property in JSON Pointer notation. All features must have a root level source which is the default source if a specific property's source is not specified.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: The part's geometry. It must be a polygon or multipolygon.

table:columns.name: building_id
table:columns.description: The building ID to which this part belongs

table:columns.name: version
table:columns.description: Version number of the feature, incremented in each Overture release where the geometry or attributes of this feature changed.

visual.title: Overture buildings vector tiles
visual.description: Overture's prebuilt PMTiles archive for the whole buildings theme. This collection's features are in the `building_part` layer.
